lines: The audit of composer.lock could not be read: composer audit ended with exit code 0. Its abandoned packages were not checked.
The 572 shipped packages by licence: MIT 488, ISC 24, GPL-3.0-or-later 21, BSD-2-Clause 12, BSD-3-Clause 9, Apache-2.0 7, AGPL-3.0-or-later 4, AGPL-3.0 2, and 5 licences more.
The app is under AGPL-3.0-or-later, as appinfo/info.xml declares; licences.json held each licence against it.
The advisories were not checked (NO_ADVISORIES=1 or --no-advisories): this report says nothing about vulnerable packages.
